none: PAS KENT-4B1D32: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Bust right. Inscription: ....P F AVG. Reverse: Two soldiers holding one standard. Inscription: GLOR(IA) EXER(CIT)VS. Mint mark: I/PARL. Mint name: Arles (France). Reece period 17. Die axis: 12 o'clock. This coin is in very fine condition with slight wear. It has dark green patina but one edge is broken and it has some, slight surface corrosion especially on the obverse. This coin is likely to date to 340-341AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 62 no. 599A, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon James, Seaby 1986 reprint 1994, page 28-29 no. 98 & 99 and RIC VIII,…
